    mod = 10**9 + 7
    if t == 0:
        if n == 0:
            return 0
        return mod
    cnt = n // dp[t]
    if n % dp[t] == 0:
        return t * cnt
    return min(
        solve(abs(n - dp[t] * (cnt + 1)), t - 1) + t,
        solve(n - dp[t] * cnt, t - 1)
    ) + (0 if n == 0 else 0)
